how-27-01-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the star, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-27-01-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the star, then tap 3 things you notice.

how-27-01-compare.page: Put the sun lamp under one tray and the freezer pack under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-27-01-compare.say: Put the sun lamp under one tray and the freezer pack under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.

how-27-01-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-27-01-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.

how-27-01-det.page: Pick 3 files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the change. Predict if heat was added or taken away, and watch the place appear.
how-27-01-det.say: Pick three files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then name the change. Predict if heat was added or taken away, and watch the place appear.

how-27-01-partc.page: Draw the full state-change cycle for water. Show solid, liquid, and gas with arrows between them. Label each arrow: melting, freezing, evaporation, or condensation. Use color to show hot and cold.
how-27-01-partc.say: Draw the full state-change cycle for water. Show solid, liquid, and gas with arrows between them. Label each arrow: melting, freezing, evaporation, or condensation. Use color to show hot and cold.
